The end of the tunnel is in sight. But the winding path took its toll on my patience today. The days until I reach my goal blend together, it seems, like the grains of sand trickling down into the vast hourglass of the shore. Determination propels me forward despite the nagging feeling that there is something I may be missing. I keep going. I am nearing the finish line, and I can feel the rhythm of my feet movement getting in tune as I inch closer. Judgment day is close and I am ready to take on whatever the future holds.
